arxiv-1410-4274.description: Abstract We consider multiple testing with false discovery rate (FDR) control when p-values have discrete and heterogeneous null distributions. arxiv-2103-03646.description: Abstract . There exist several methods for computing exact solutions of algebraic differential equations. Most of the methods, however, do not ensure existence and uniqueness of the solutions and might fail after several steps, or are restricted to linear equations.

arxiv-2104-13653.title: On the Martingale Representation with Respect to the super-Brownian Filtration
arxiv-2104-13653.creator: Christian Mandler, Ludger Overbeck
arxiv-2104-13653.description: Abstract We derive the explicit form of the martingale representation for square-integrable processes that are martingales with respect to the natural filtration of the super-Brownian motion. This is done by using a weak extension of the Dupire derivative for functionals of superprocesses.

arxiv-2203-15321.title: Noise-robust Speech Recognition with 10 Minutes Unparalleled In-domain Data
arxiv-2203-15321.creator: Chen Chen, Nana Hou, Yuchen Hu, Shashank Shirol, Eng Siong Chng \sthanks This research is supported by the Air Traffic Management Research Institute of Nanyang Technological University
arxiv-2203-15321.description: Abstract Noise-robust speech recognition systems require large amounts of training data including noisy speech data and corresponding transcripts to achieve state-of-the-art performances in face of various practical environments. However, such plenty of in-domain data is not always available in the real-life world.

arxiv-2209-13112.title: Automated Sex Classification of Children’s Voices and Changes in Differentiating Factors with Age
arxiv-2209-13112.creator: Fuling Chen, Roberto Togneri, Murray Maybery, Diana Weiting Tan
arxiv-2209-13112.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Fuling Chen, Roberto Togneri, Murray Maybery, Diana Weiting Tan. Sex classification of children’s voices allows for an investigation of the development of secondary sex characteristics which has been a key interest in the field of speech analysis. This research investigated a broad range of acoustic features from scripted and spontaneous speech and applied a hierarchical clustering-based machine learning model to distinguish the sex of children aged between 5 and 15 years.

arxiv-2212-13552.title: Stabilization of the Kawahara-Kadomtsev-Petviashvili equation with time-delayed feedback Thanks: *Corresponding author: roberto.capistranofilho@ufpe.br
arxiv-2212-13552.creator: Roberto de A. Capistrano-Filho*, Victor H. Gonzalez Martinez, Juan Ricardo Muñoz
arxiv-2212-13552.description: Abstract . Results of stabilization for the higher order of the Kadomtsev-Petviashvili equation are presented in this manuscript. Precisely, we prove with two different approaches that under the presence of a damping mechanism and an internal delay term (anti-damping) the solutions of the Kawahara-Kadomtsev-Petviashvili equation are locally and globally exponentially stable.

arxiv-2404-10594.title: Nonparametric isotropy test for spatial point processes using random rotations
arxiv-2404-10594.creator: Chiara Fend, Claudia Redenbach
arxiv-2404-10594.description: Abstract In spatial statistics, point processes are often assumed to be isotropic meaning that their distribution is invariant under rotations. Statistical tests for the null hypothesis of isotropy found in the literature are based either on asymptotics or on Monte Carlo simulation of a parametric null model.

arxiv-2405-01012.title: Correcting Biased Centered Kernel Alignment Measures in Biological and Artificial Neural Networks
arxiv-2405-01012.creator: Alex Murphy, Joel Zylberberg, Alona Fyshe
arxiv-2405-01012.description: Abstract Centred Kernel Alignment (CKA) has recently emerged as a popular metric to compare activations from biological and artificial neural networks (ANNs) in order to quantify the alignment between internal representations derived from stimuli sets (e.g. images, text, video) that are presented to both systems ( Sucholutsky et al., 2023 ; Han et al., 2023 ) .

arxiv-2409-20264.title: First Order System Least Squares Neural Networks
arxiv-2409-20264.creator: Joost A. A. Opschoor, Philipp C. Petersen, Christoph Schwab
arxiv-2409-20264.description: Abstract We introduce a conceptual framework for numerically solving linear elliptic, parabolic, and hyperbolic PDEs on bounded, polytopal domains in euclidean spaces by deep neural networks. The PDEs are recast as minimization of a least-squares (LSQ for short) residual of an equivalent, well-posed first-order system, over parametric families of deep neural networks.

pmc-11225441.creator: Emmanuel Kobina Mesi Edzie, Klenam Dzefi-Tettey, Edmund Kwakye Brakohiapa, Philip Narteh Gorleku, Eric Aidoo, Stephen Kwaku Amoah, Samuel Asiamah, Frank Quarshie, Obed Nimo, Amrit Raj, Joshua Mensah Kpobi, Evans Boadi, Richard Ato Edzie, Veronica Turkson, Henry Kusodzi, Abdul Raman Asemah

pmc-11427351.title: Early detection of chemotherapy-induced cardiotoxicity in breast cancer patients: a comprehensive analysis using speckle tracking echocardiography
pmc-11427351.creator: Ning Zhang, Na Wang, Yanyan Zhang, Ya Liu, Miaomiao Pei, Gaiqin Liu, Xinle Jia, Xuejia Guo
pmc-11427351.description: IntroductionChemotherapy-induced cardiotoxicity poses a significant challenge in the treatment of breast cancer, potentially compromising both the efficacy of cancer therapy and cardiac health of patients. This study aimed to enhance the early detection of cardiotoxic effects by integrating advanced imaging modalities and biomarker analysis, thereby facilitating timely interventions to mitigate cardiac risk.

pmc-12539411.title: Research Trends and Hotspots in JAK Inhibitors for Ulcerative Colitis: A Bibliometric Analysis From 2015 to 2024
pmc-12539411.creator: Yifei Wang, Zhiying Wang, Pengfei Lou, Hong Ni, Yang Yang, Guangyao Chen, Shuxin Zhang
pmc-12539411.description: ObjectiveTo systematically investigate international trends and dynamics in research on Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitor applications for ulcerative colitis (UC) management over the past decade (2015–2024) and delineate current research frontiers.MethodsPublications was retrieved from the Web of Science core collection database and subjected to bibliometric analysis. VOSviewers, CiteSpace, Scimago Graphica, and Excel were used to conduct this bibliometric analysis and visualization.

pmc-13012850.title: Review of the effect of atrazine on the HPG axes and steroidogenic pathways in males: relevance for testicular and prostate cancer
pmc-13012850.creator: Ralph L. Cooper, James W. Simpkins, Charles Breckenridge
pmc-13012850.description: Subacute, subchronic, and chronic rodent studies on atrazine were evaluated to determine the no observed adverse effect levels (NOAEL) for male reproductive toxicity and carcinogenicity. In vitro studies were also evaluated for the effect of atrazine on molecular pathways related to male reproductive function and potential mechanisms for cancer. Gestational exposure to high doses of atrazine delayed male development post-partum.

pmc-13087513.title: Relation of Prostatic and Urinary Bladder Ultrasound Parameters in Patients With Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia
pmc-13087513.creator: Bhishma Prasad Pokharel, Narayan Bikram Thapa, Jeni Singh, Yashoda Dangi, Dip Bahadur Singh
pmc-13087513.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundBenign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) is a prevalent condition among aging males, leading to progressive lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS) due to prostate enlargement and bladder dysfunction. This study aimed to assess the correlation between prostate volume (PV) and key ultrasonographic parameters, including intravesical prostatic protrusion (IPP), bladder wall thickness (BWT), and post‐void residual urine (PVRU), to evaluate their clinical significance in BPH management.MethodsA cross‐sectional study was conducted on 105 male patients diagnosed with BPH.
